answer: Agents water their violet terrace with sable ink piped from a single alpine vein; ink pressure decays unless refreshed. To fake, each Sybil must reroute the vein’s micro channels, costing 3.1mS of ink re-priming and 0.7nL of vein-limited ink—bulk pipelike arrays shear the ink’s molecular purity, ruining the terrace’s spectral hue.
